name: Next Beverly Hills Committee Regular Meeting Agenda (PDF)
agenda_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I Next Beverly Hills Committee
  will conduct a Regular Meeting, at the following time and place, and will address the
  agenda listed below:

  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  Municipal Gallery
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  IN-PERSON ITELEPHONIC IVIDEO CONFERENCE MEETING

  Beverly Hills Liaison Committee Meeting
  https:llbeverlyhills-org.zoom.us!mylnextbh
  Meeting ID: 511 714 8143
  Passcode: 90210

  You can also dial in by phone:
  +1 346248 7799 US
  +18335480282 USToll-free

  One tap mobile
  +13462487799,,51 17148143#,,,,*90210# US
  +1 8335480282,,51 17148143#,,,,*9021 0# US Toll-free

  Thursday, August 17, 2023
  6:30 PM
Please be advised that pre-entry metal detector screening requirements are now in place
in City Hall. Members of the public are requested to plan visits accordingly.

In the interest of maintaining appropriate social distancing, members of the public can view this
meeting through live webcastat www.beverlyhills.orallive and on BH Channel 10 or Channel
35 on Spectrum Cable, and can participate in the teleconference/video conference by using the
link above. Written comments may be emailed to mayorandcitycouncilbeverlyhills.org and
will also be taken during the meeting when the topic is being reviewed by the Beverly Hills City
Council Liaison / Next Beverly Hills Committee. Beverly Hills Liaison meetings will be in-person
at City Hall.

  AGENDA

1) Public Comment
  a. Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the Committee
  on any item not listed on the agenda.

2) Welcome & Introductions
  a. Next Beverly Hills Chair Noah Etessami and Vice Chair Charles Smith
  b. Mayor Julian A. Gold, M.D. and Vice Mayor Lester Friedman
  c. Introduction of New Attendees
  d. Special Speakers
  i. Giacomino Drago, Restauranteur

3) New Business
   a. Events
  i. Upcoming Events
  1. Next Night (Scheduled for Saturday, September 23, 2023)
  2. All other upcoming events
  ii. Prospective Events
  b. Subcommittee Updates
  c. City Council Liaisons Civic Awareness Updates
  —

  d. Next Up City Announcements for the Next Generation
  —

4) Current Business
  a. Open Discussion (Share interesting next gen-related information, events, invites, and
  ideas)

5) Future Agenda Items Discussion

6) Adjournment
  a. The upcoming Next Beverly Hills Committee regular meeting is scheduled for
  Thursday, September 21, 2023 at 6:30 p.m.

City Clerk

Posted: August 11, 2023
